Status: 🐞 Bug Confirmed (Open Defect)
Tested on: 2026-10-28
Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/editor/issue_223_artwork_info_save_defect_sanity.spec.ts (Playwright · Chromium) & Source Mutation Audit & qa_testing/scripts/record-issue-223-headless-clean.cjs (Headless Video + Live Virtual Address Bar Recording)

Final Verdict 🐞 Bug Confirmed (Open Defect)

1. Technical Evaluation & Root Cause Analysis (17 September 2026 Finding)

  1. Root Cause Analysis in Source Code:
    • In src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/images/image-info/image-info.component.ts:
      • Text mutations (updateArtworkInfo) update the active artwork object in memory: 
        public updateArtworkInfo = debounce((prop: string, value: string) => {
  this._validateValues();
  this.editorService.activeArtwork[prop] = value.trim();
  this.editorService.activeArtwork.edited_description = true;
  this.editorService.updateLogActivity('Update artwork ' + prop.replace(/_/g, ' '));
  this.editorService.updateUndoRedoState();
  // ✖ MISSING: this.editorService.dataHasChanges = true;
}, 500);
      • Numeric year updates (updateYear) and toggle switches (handleOnChangeSwitchArtworkInfo) also fail to set the change flag.
    • In src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/editor.component.ts (isSaveChangesDisable()), line 880: 
      public isSaveChangesDisable(): boolean {
  return (
    this.editorService.onSavingData ||
    !this.editorService.dataHasChanges || // ✖ LOCKED: dataHasChanges is FALSE!
    this.editorService.blockUserAction ||
    !this.editorService.exhibitionDataValid ||
    this.editorService.previewMode
  );
}
    • Because dataHasChanges is never flipped to true, the "Save Changes" button in the editor toolbar remains permanently disabled.
    • If a user solely edits artwork details (e.g. Set Price, Dimension Info, Materials, or Description) without moving or scaling an artwork node in 3D space, the application never enables the Save button, stranding changes in memory and causing complete data loss on page exit or tab switch.
  2. Comparison with Other Editor Components:
    • Contrasting components such as AlignImageComponent (line 71), RotationImageComponent (line 75), ScalingImageComponent (line 471), and PublishComponent (line 317) all explicitly call this.editorService.dataHasChanges = true;.
  3. Recommended Developer Remediation:
    • In src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/images/image-info/image-info.component.ts:
      • Inside updateArtworkInfo(): append this.editorService.dataHasChanges = true;
      • Inside updateYear(): append this.editorService.dataHasChanges = true;
      • Inside handleOnChangeSwitchArtworkInfo(): append this.editorService.dataHasChanges = true;
    • This single-line fix will immediately activate the Save button upon user text modification.

Final step of the linting roadmap: enable deeper TypeScript checks and make linting an automated local quality gate.

Primary suspect: line endings. .prettierrc.json sets "endOfLine": "lf". On a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true, every file lands as CRLF and Prettier reports nearly all of them as unformatted — which matches the observed ratio.

issues.display_title: Issue #1926: chore(deploy): install with pnpm, pick deploy target from branch, add deployment guide
issues.main_description_html:
Background

  1. npm install (and npm install --force) started crashing with Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut'). The repo moved to pnpm on 2026-04-13 and package-lock.json was deleted, so npm resolved the newest versions allowed by package.json on every install. @angular/build 21.2.28 (released 2026-10-22) makes npm crash; pnpm-lock.yaml pins 21.2.7. The deploy playbook ran npm install --force on builder-server, so the next deploy would have failed.
  2. Every release overwrote master's live deploy values with dev values. development and master each hard-coded their own IP, build command and inventory host in ansible-deploy.yml, and release merges kept bringing the dev values into master (fixed by hand in c65021d6e on 2026-09-08 and b8a16c950 on 2026-10-19).
  3. There was no written deployment guide.

Goal

Deploys install the locked dependency versions, one playbook works for both branches without manual fixes after a release, and DevOps has a guide to follow.

Scope

  • ansible-deploy.yml
    • Install with npx --yes pnpm@11.21.0 install --frozen-lockfile (pnpm doesn't need to be installed on builder-server). The build still runs npm run <script>.
    • One shared file for every branch; the target comes from the checked-out branch, so the deploy command stays ansible-playbook ansible-deploy.yml:
      • master → live (192.168.1.232, build:ssr, villume-admin-live)
      • development → dev (192.168.1.94, build:dev:ssr, villume-admin-dev)
      • Detached HEAD (e.g. Jenkins): branch read from GIT_BRANCH
      • Any other branch: the deploy stops before anything is built or shipped
      • -e target=dev|live overrides the branch
  • docs/DEPLOY.md: deployment guide for dev-live (https://dev.villume.com) and live (https://villume.com), including why npm used to work and now crashes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • AC-001: The playbook installs dependencies with pnpm from pnpm-lock.yaml.
  • AC-002: The same ansible-deploy.yml deploys master to live and development to dev, and stops on any other branch (dry-run --check for 6 scenarios passed).
  • AC-003: docs/DEPLOY.md exists on development and master.

Related

  • GoThru-API-New and gothru-dashboard have the same kind of guide (docs/DEPLOY.md).

Result

Implementation

  • PR: #1924 (merged into development 2026-10-22, 83ec7ff8b)
  • PR: #1925 release/2026-10-23 (merged into master 2026-10-22, c6768aac9). The one-time conflict in ansible-deploy.yml was resolved by taking development's version, so both branches now share the same file.
  • Key commits: 4d8a0e5ba (install with pnpm via npx), d95cce104 (deployment guide), e9aecdc0d (deploy target from the checked-out branch), 796e5dad6 (admin URLs), e08970e11 (drop node_modules cleanup step)
  • Guide: docs/DEPLOY.md

Testing

  • ansible-playbook --check against a local inventory: master, development, feature branch (stops), feature branch with -e target=dev, detached HEAD with GIT_BRANCH=origin/master, detached HEAD without GIT_BRANCH (stops), all as expected.
  • npm run build:dev:ssr on top of pnpm's node_modules/ succeeded locally.

Before the next deploy: check Node ≥ 22.13 on builder-server (AC-004).
